test.summary: SPM - OKR - Updating Hyperlink custom field values across OKR views
test.description:
This test verifies updating Hyperlink custom field values across all supported OKR views.

Covered areas:

* OKR Detail page
* Overview 
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving Hyperlink custom field values
* Updating hyperlink label and URL values
* Validation of invalid URL values
* Verifying hyperlink label is displayed correctly
* Verifying hyperlink opens the correct URL
* Deleting Hyperlink custom field value

rag.text:
Test: TC-6149 — SPM - OKR - Updating Hyperlink custom field values across OKR views
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
This test verifies updating Hyperlink custom field values across all supported OKR views.

Covered areas:

* OKR Detail page
* Overview 
* Side panel

Validation scope:

* Editing and saving Hyperlink custom field values
* Updating hyperlink label and URL values
* Validation of invalid URL values
* Verifying hyperlink label is displayed correctly
* Verifying hyperlink opens the correct URL
* Deleting Hyperlink custom field value

Steps:
1. *Preconditions:*

* Hyperlink custom field is created and assigned to Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result (used-in)
* Existing OKRs contain predefined values for Hyperlink fields
* User has permissions to edit OKRs and custom field values
   Expected: 
2. Open OKR Overview of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6149 SPM - OKR - Updating Hyperlink custom field values across OKR views
   Expected: Overview module is opened. The following OKRs are visible:

* Strategic theme 1
* Objective 1
* Key result 1
3. Navigate to Hyperlink field
   Expected: Hyperlink custom field is visible for Strategic Theme, Objective and Key Result.

The following field values are displayed correctly for each item:

* Strategic Theme - "OpenAI" 
* Objective - "[https://www.atlassian.com|https://www.atlassian.com]"
* Key Result - "Appfire"
4. Navigate to the Strategic theme Hyperlink custom field and click on link
   Expected: External link confirmation modal is displayed with message:
"*BigPicture* is sending you to an external page. Ensure you trust that page before you continue.

[https://openai.com/|https://openai.com/]"
5. Click Continue
   Expected: [https://openai.com/|https://openai.com/] page is opened in new tab
6. Navigate to the Strategic theme Hyperlink custom field and click edit button
   Expected: Edit hyperlink" modal is displayed with Label and Link fields populated with the current values
7. Click Delete value button
   Expected: Modal closed and value disappear form Hyperlink field in Overview
8. Navigate to the Key result Hyperlink custom field and click edit button
   Expected: Edit hyperlink" modal is displayed with Label and Link fields populated with the current values
9. Remove label and Update value and click Save
   Data: newValue: openai-com
   Expected: Validation message "{color:#ff5630}must be URL string{color}" is displayed and invalid URL value cannot be saved
10. Update value and click Save
   Data: label: GitHub

link: [https://github.com|https://github.com]
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
11. Click on the grey area of the Key result row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key result. Hyperlink field is visible with correct value.
12. Navigate to the Key result Hyperlink custom field and click edit button
   Expected: Edit hyperlink" modal is displayed with Label and Link fields populated with the current values
13. Update value and click Save
   Data: label: Jira

link: [https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira|https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira]
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
14. Open Key result in the detail page and navigate to the Info section
   Expected: Detail page is opened. Hyperlink field is visible with correct value.
15. Navigate to the Key result Hyperlink custom field and click edit button
   Expected: Edit hyperlink" modal is displayed with Label and Link fields populated with the current values
16. Update value and click Save
   Data: label: Google Maps

link: [https://maps.google.com|https://maps.google.com]
   Expected: The new field value is saved and displayed correctly
